name: Move Myntra SJIT data to Google Bigquery
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **Myntra SJIT** as the data source.
2.  Select your added Google Bigquery data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your Myntra SJIT using the **+** icon with your Name, Access Token and Refresh Token.
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/myntra-sjit/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
